title: genux HTML catalog
description: A custom A2UI catalog with one component: a sandboxed region of model-written HTML. It exists to show open-ended and mixed generation on top of A2UI. It is NOT part of the A2UI standard.
instructions: Use HtmlFrame only for something the basic catalog cannot express (an interactive calculator, a custom chart). The html must be one self-contained document with inline CSS/JS and no network access. Inside it, call genux.emit(name, payload) to send an event; the renderer turns it into an A2UI action whose sourceComponentId is the HtmlFrame id.

HtmlFrame.description: Renders model-written HTML inside a sandboxed iframe with a Content-Security-Policy. Events from the document become A2UI actions.

title.description: A short title shown above the frame.

caption.description: Text under the frame; bind it to the data model to show agent feedback.

allowedEvents.description: Event names the document may emit. Others are dropped by the renderer.
